title: ModeloJson
description: Canonical schema of the Fundamento Modelo. The root validates the exported modelo.json; $defs describe every Key Entity and every source-file format (set files and the data files).

core.description: Facts of the core (Spec 001, FR-10): the reference Aspekto whose values live in core.

TextTransform.description: Text transformation of a typography role (Spec 001, D-11). DTCG has no field for it; the values are platform-neutral.

ColorValue.description: DTCG 2025.10 color: colour space plus three components, optional alpha and a 6-digit hex fallback.

DimensionValue.description: DTCG dimension. Only px is accepted: a platform-neutral reference unit (1 px = 1 pt = 1 dp), FR-09a.

CubicBezierValue.description: [P1x, P1y, P2x, P2y]; the x coordinates lie in [0, 1].

GroupExtensions.description: Extensions of a nested group. The Fundamento key is only allowed on tokens and on the set root.

DtcgToken.description: A DTCG 2025.10 token. $value is a literal of the token's type or a whole-value alias {a.b.c}. With an explicit $type the value is checked here; an inherited type is checked by the Modelo validation.

DtcgGroup.description: A DTCG group. Child keys are name segments ([a-z0-9]+, FR-13a); the canonical token name is the dot-joined path.

DtcgNode.description: A token (object with $value) or a group (anything else).

TokenSetFile.description: Root of a set file (vortaro/sets/<set-name>.json): a DTCG group whose extension carries the set ID and its kondicxoj (empty for core).

License.description: An SPDX license expression, or `proprietary` for rights that are not openly licensed.

IdNamespace.description: ID namespace of an external Aspekto package (Spec 001, D-06): 2 to 8 lowercase letters.

Fonto.description: A font family an Aspekto uses. Font files never enter the core repository; the fallback stack lives only in the fontFamily token value.

scripts.description: Writing systems the family covers, as ISO 15924 codes (Latn, Cyrl, Arab, Hans, …); at least one (Spec 001, T018b).

Iso15924.description: An ISO 15924 script code: four letters, the first uppercase (e.g. Latn, Cyrl, Hans).

Tavoloj.description: Layers of the brand package (Spec 001, D-20): the Aspekto package is the brand package and the Vortaro is one of its layers. Phase 1 reserves only the key vida, with the empty value {}; other keys are allowed and ignored by validation.

AspektoFile.description: aspekto.json of an Aspekto package (Spec 001, D-05). `id` is the DimensioValoro ID of the Aspekto; `idNamespace` is required for every package except the reference Aspekto (checked on composition).

Dimensio.description: An adaptation dimension. priority is unique; 1 is lowest and higher priorities win in resolution. The values of the aspekto Dimensio come from the loaded Aspekto packages (Spec 001, D-05), so dimensioj.json lists none for it; every other Dimensio lists its values (dimensio-default-invalid otherwise).

referenceAspekto.description: Only on the aspekto Dimensio: the reference Aspekto whose values live in core (Spec 001, FR-10).

aspekto.description: Scopes the entry to one Aspekto; entries in an Aspekto package carry their Aspekto (Spec 001, D-10).

ReguloAppliesTo.description: Which tokens the Regulo governs; explain finds a token's Reguloj only through this field (Spec 002, D-02). A token matches when any criterion matches. Token patterns may use * for one segment and a trailing ** for one or more.

ReguloSojlo.description: The numeric threshold of a measuring Regulo; the enforcer reads it and agents cite it (Spec 002, D-02, D-06; Spec 004 adds the metrics and the upper bound).

JugxoArtikoloRef.description: A constitution Article (I to XIII), for Jugxoj that record a deviation from the constitution itself.

aspekto.description: Scopes the entry to one Aspekto; entries in an Aspekto package carry their Aspekto (Spec 001, D-10).

backdrop.description: The surface a translucent background lies on. An overlay has no colour of its own; with a backdrop the check composites background over it and measures the result (Spec 004). The backdrop itself must be opaque.

aux.description: Alternative pair (aŭ, 'or'): the KontrastParo holds when the main pair or this pair meets the threshold of the same kategorio (Spec 002, FR-07). Not allowed for text categories; requires a kialo.

kialo.description: Why the pair exists or why its alternative is enough; required with aux (Spec 002, D-09).

IdsLock.description: data/ids.lock.json: every ID ever issued, with its entity type and status. Keys are sorted.

package.description: The Aspekto package that holds the set (Spec 001, D-08); absent for core sets.

ResolvedToken.description: A token's final value in one combination, with aliases fully inlined, plus its provenance.

textTransform.description: Text transformation of a typography token and the set that states it; the last active set that states one wins (Spec 001, D-11). Absent when no set states one.

Rezolvo.description: Result of one resolution: the complete assignment (dimensio -> valoro) and every token with value and provenance.

Ero.description: A component (Spec 003). Lives with its Skemo in data/eroj/<name>/skemo.json.

Skemo.description: The machine-readable specification of an Ero (Spec 003, data-model §2): the single source of every projection.

SkemoPartProperty.description: Platform-neutral part properties (Art. VIII); the mapping to CSS or another platform is Celo knowledge in the projections.

SkemoPartSource.description: Where a part property gets its token: bindings keyed by props and state (by), one token (fixed), or the token of another part property (sameAs, 'part.property').

EroFile.description: data/eroj/<name>/skemo.json: one Ero and its Skemo, two entities with their own IDs (plan D-02).

EroInstance.description: One use of an Ero in a design or code: the input of check_usage and of a Jugxo ekzemplo.

JugxoEkzemplo.description: A machine-readable example of the Jugxo: instances right (approved) or wrong (rejected), optionally for one Regulo.

Sxablono.description: A template or pattern (layout, page type, flow). Schema only in Phase 0.

Projekcio.description: A derivation from the Modelo into one output target. Schema only in Phase 0.

Celo.description: An output target of a Projekcio. Target-specific knowledge lives in package code, never here. Schema only in Phase 0.

AspektoEntry.description: Convenience view of one value of the aspekto Dimensio (it shares the DimensioValoro ID).

external.description: True when the package lies outside the core repository.

package.description: The Aspekto package that holds the set (Spec 001, D-08); absent for core sets.

AspektoAspiro.description: A design goal one Aspekto sets itself (Spec 004, plan D-03): the same measurement as a Regulo, its own bound and its own reason, checked only for this Aspekto. Reguloj enforce accessibility and structure for every brand; an Aspiro is taste, and taste belongs to the brand.
